notes: Crosscut: the two cuts cross into an X; centre on the target body; the cuts land on frames 1 and 3; mirror it when the target is to the west
Thunder Tap: the bolt strikes down; anchor = the target's feet; hit on frame 2; the stun stars take over after it
Hundred Hits: rapid strike lines, points EAST; loop it in front of the player, centred between the player and the target, turned to the facing
Shatter Strike: the burst on the target; anchor = its feet; plays with fx-stick-shatter-ring (the white pole frames PixelLab drew first are left out: the player's own stick does that)
Shatter Strike: the shockwave ring and cracks on the ground; same anchor as the impact (the target's feet); under players and mobs; starts with the impact
Phantom Sticks: an afterimage dissolving; anchor = where its feet were; plays as each afterimage ends
